purpose: Team D against team D (data pool), team preview and six steps of case fz_91_1030 of the differential loop (step G12, seed 91, battle 1030 of the run), cut after the step that failed. The engine kept +1 for the fainted holder and drew a tie that the reference did not (E_INVARIANT, tape 7 of 7): the opposite case to d04.
